input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: research programme cell-fidelity, milestone 5zf (pick_track draw): a ten-cycle per-design plating kinetic exponent and the oracle exponent each set needs
errors: One fresh DFN run (Ai2020@0.5875x design 1) was killed for memory with 3 workers while dev ran alongside; retried with WORKERS=1 as the plan fixed, nothing dropped.

First draft of the slope estimator used 5zd's coarse R table (about two cells inside cycles 2-10) and was 15% biased on a synthetic case; caught by the new unit test before dev, fixed with a fine table over [0, 1.05 L(10)].
integrity_issues: H167's first committed plan draft used the k_fit IQR alone, which one dev pool (loaded/Chen2020@1.375x, IQR 16 because most designs sit at the bound) already failed; amended to also count designs at the bound before any fresh run started, and the amendment is disclosed in the LOG plan entry and visible in the PR's commit history.

doc_friction.issue: The law's definitions (eta, dU_eta, R) are spread across 5zb-5ze entries and scripts that import each other four levels deep (asym -> consistent -> loaded -> kinetic); recovering what to change took reading three scripts. A short 'current law' block in README or THEORY.md would save the next run time.

notes: Dev on 512 committed designs (16 pools), then a pre-registered fresh bench of 128 DFN runs (seed 24, ~33 min on 3 workers). H167-H171 all supported: per-design kappa from ten cycles forecasts worse than 25.3/V on all four fresh pools; LG M50 lever rises <1 mV in ten cycles; oracle kappa* 45 and 32/V on LG M50 vs 20 and 23 on Ai2020/NCA_Kim2011. Checks run locally: tests/test_kappa.py and test_asym.py (9 passed), research/_homepage/build.py ok, research_live_links, check_md_links ok, cite_check ok, programme_check ok, post front matter/links/similarity ok.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: a battery-modelling PhD student designing two estimators, a dev diagnosis on 512 runs, a pre-registered 128-run DFN bench and write-up

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
